unit: Intermediate plus its reachable measured region, within one patent, target, assay metadata context and endpoint.

screen.sar_screen: Within-cohort strongest decile with cutoff ties; five-neighbor Morgan/Tanimoto predictions withholding entire region; describe enrichment, residuals and chemical diversity, no multiple-testing claims.
screen.ranking: Pareto screen over entry cost, postentry cost drop, strong compounds, enrichment and region-withheld residual; activities explicitly used to nominate retrospective demos.

primary.policy: Paid platform preparation followed by inventory-aware exploration
controls: Fixed standalone prices with physical inventory reuse
primary.budget_range: 10% to50% of original canonical reaction-union pool cost, fixed before policy outcomes.
primary.score: Minimum of the three mean paired AUC differences, in percentage points. Equivalent to investment AUC minus the strongest mean baseline AUC.
primary.confidence_interval: 4000 paired resamples using the same seed indices across all three contrasts, then minimum of bootstrap mean contrasts.
primary.starts: Primary structural outside-region starts confirmed not to contain the intermediate; unrestricted starts reported separately.
primary.entry: Actual remaining minimum preparation price after three paid seeds; full nominal source entry price also reported.
primary.additional_control: Pay for the same intermediate then use SAR-only rankings; distinguishes preparation from exploiting the newly cheap region.

scope_refinement: Initial screen used measured terminal products. A source audit exposed an assayed internal molecule, so broaden to all measured prepared molecules and retain terminal-only runs as sensitivity. Original inputs/results stay immutable.
limits: Source-frontier stocks are not verified purchased building blocks.
Finalists receive source checks and separately versioned known-preparation/collapsed-operation corrections.
Recorded absence of a bypass does not prove chemical necessity.
No quantity, yield, failed-reaction, assay or procurement prices.
Retrospective opportunity selection is not an independently validated prospective acquisition algorithm.
Multiple compounds/contexts from the same patent are not independent observations.
